source_caveats: The fixed PDF displays the complete product space. The openness estimate mixes ζ and ζ′ in print; the witness is explicitly an interior ζ′ before and after the estimate. The printed dense-boundary argument covers the point ζ=1 after reducing to a dense set away from that point when translating D.
The source proves full cluster set C generically; the original question asks independence of ζ.

On p. 18 the printed last inequality uses the prefix at ζ₀ immediately before concluding at ζ′=λζ₀. The printed density construction permits λ arbitrarily close to 1, and the prefix is a fixed polynomial. Keep the printed estimate and identify the suppressed continuity estimate.
